notes.title: V 0.36 Patch notes
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I hope you are doing great!
Here are the patch notes for the update V 0.36 !
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32442993/a5077795ffb8e55b2c0ff08fb1871a856ddedbd6.png[/img]
On this update there are a few visual and functional changes and implementation , the biggest change was made to the code side.

[b]Continues Farming:[/b] 
Now farming is done until cancel by moving or when finish looting ,showing the progress in a loading bar.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32442993/8ced57045e2320f01b2dba378ccab586bad7b370.png[/img]
[b]Container Chest [/b]:
The texture of the container chest was change to display in a better way what is the front side and to make it fit into the environment style better.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32442993/51540512c82f6a31010b036e62968fd9e4a5f6e0.png[/img]
[b]Events Log Ui[/b] :
Added a new ui(text window) that will display events .For now the damage received by the Player,Player's Monsters and Wilds Monsters , also the damage received from hunger and other survival stats and it displays the shopping events when you buy and sell how much you spend or get while using the store. This feature will be improved in future patches more.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32442993/22cd7aa620b7ac19cdd74dfd445fff59217c97f0.png[/img] 
[b]Visual feedback[/b] :
Added effect for when you can select your first monster in the table so you know you have to interact with them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32442993/3b4851ee6fa486bb480fee9985df2ead6f776756.png[/img]

[b]First Monster is 100% now![/b] :
Now when you catch your first wild monster it will have a 100% capture rate, this works only in the first tower floor and when you haven't capture any wild monster.
[i]Fixed Interaction Range[/i]:
Some times when you interacted with a big object from the very edge it would cancel the interaction , but not anymore!.

I added a new testing branch that contains the previews update(v0.35) you can always switch back to that version if you want/need this branch will be update in the future to keep the previews patch in the future.

Well that would be all for this one and remember that your feedback is very important so if you have any ideas/suggestions for improvement make sure to post them this will help to make a better game!
If you find any bug while playing it would be very much appreciated if you report them on the discussions section and thanks to all of you have reported them.
That would be all for now and like always [b]Thank you[/b] for your support! and believing in The Capture Worlds!

will blink with a red color when they are under 20%

Running effect was added 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32442993/04a4ed78618e6d51ed7e79be20a076a7409a63c3.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32442993/407b44f06db6c0804b713375378842c9546dbb08.png[/img]
Portable Bed was added ,this can be used to sleep while in the tower
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32442993/638a0eac40a0a43fd70b1ce238b7acd2b71dceff.png[/img]
You can use it to restore hp or skip the night, you can get them from the
General shop for $100 (they will not be saved so next time you visit the tower it will be gone)
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32442993/61e4ee28290accbd34214fd07d1008c9f2b13590.png[/img]

Drinking and Eating now have animations
The Items that drop now they will levitate after a while and won’t keep rolling.
Added a Sleeping Screen
The Maps in the tower now load at least once each before they loop back to the start gain
So you won't be seen the same map that often.
Skills of type ray/beam can be cancelled by pressing the spacebar
Speed up the animations for the pickup ,axe and pickaxe.
Fixed that the pickup animation wasn’t been played.
Fixed that you weren’t able to remove beds.
Fixed that when you defeated a monster while it was using a ray skill 
the ray effect would stay sometimes.
Added the icon of the target of the quest in the quests board.
The image that is displayed when dragging now it doesn’t have a background
Removed the Limitation in the Name creation for the characters.
When added the Quest tracking text to the Hide HUD.
Fixed a bug where you couldn’t use some items from the inventory but only in the shortcuts.
Added an arrow effect to the starting tutorial since there was a chance some people wouldn't see that they had to pick up the capture card.
For now the player can’t get affected by status effect by being attacked by the wild monsters.

Over all clean up to the inventory code ,this will allow me to work on it more easily ,I will continue to do the same in other parts of the game.
  
What’s next?
Well i have decided to add a side quest where you have to collect map pieces by defeating the “Chronos members”  and when you complete the map you will be able to go to there base and defeat there Boss. Also i will cut on the history mode to be just a middle act and a final act for now , this could change later but for now that’s the goal to get The Capture Worlds out of the early access.
Then after i finish the “Chronos Base” and the middle and final act i will change the focus to polish the gameplay and features of the game and work more in the art section to add better monsters and more npcs.


Well that would be all for this one and remember that your feedback is very important so if you have any ideas/suggestions for improvement make sure to post them this will help to make a better game!
If you find any bug while playing it would be very much appreciated if you report them on the discussions section and thanks to all of you have reported them.
That would be all for now and like always [b]Thank you[/b] for your support! and believing in The Capture Worlds!

notes.title: V 0.34 Patch notes ( Town Invasion! )
notes.content:
Hello everyone,its been a while i hope you are doing great!
Here are the patch notes for the update V0.34

The main feature of this patch is:
[b]The Town Invasions[/b]
After act 3 when you meet the "Chronos Team" they will start to invade the town every Saturday at 12 pm (in-game time) 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32442993/721e6e43df93c218b1297454db743ab47af2b36c.png[/img] 
They will  increase by one in every you defeat an invasion until they are a total of 12.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32442993/52f4678917a8a545e5c7cd5e561240749a630224.png[/img]
The first invasion will be only 1 enemy and after that you can fight them all to get the reward or you can skip the invasion by talking with this guy:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32442993/fc7f76be46a01b323d65828009916d4fba824de8.png[/img]
If you decide to defeat them all after the fight you will get a chest that contains items,the amount of items will depend on how many enemies you defeat. But make sure to loot it because it will despawn if you exit the town or the game.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32442993/22f50d723597af1478f31a28a396f310c2a531bb.png[/img] 

[b]Improvements[/b] : 
Added buttons for Store all and Store Similar to the storage , this will make things easier to manage your items.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32442993/e50dab5726a4adfb5ebc983c22ff9c2564bf1a9f.png[/img] 
Town got an update on the graphics part added some details and improve some performance. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32442993/fb1d86475beb7b092097a9bf83be7b132d0a455f.png[/img]
The water was changed and later i will have the water of the other worlds change too even the ones from the mods :
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32442993/dbb7b32a66965b18b66206a7151d4385906ca803.png[/img]
The Vs npc was change to have no loading time and when you finish the battle you will be send back to the original world you started the battle but now you can't save while in a battle vs an npc .Added a ui that displays the opponent's monster team there level and if they are OK they will be gray out.
The opponent's monsters will start to move around until you release your monster .
The map also got some graphical improvements 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32442993/0b3e0ee70e834813d53248af1b6adfdd633b9533.png[/img]
The Vs Boss map also got some graphical improvements .
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32442993/38df8207edf235d696d99c67433e3395a87933f5.png[/img]

Items like food and water will not close the item selection ring after using it this will be added to other item as needed.

Added a key to toggle all the ui(user interface) while controlling your character for now it is set to "insert" but you can change this in the launcher.

Important Note: 
This patch will be on a testing branch for a week , i will be doing more play testing on it and when i'm sure there are no game braking bugs i will move it to be the main build. You can always opt-in to try this version in the steam settings.So this patch will be on the live version next week(June 8 2019). 

I apologies for the long absence ,but i'm back to it and with more knowledge than before.It will help make the game better for sure!. 
I stated doing live streaming in YouTube while  i work in the game , drop by and say hello if you want , normally i start around 4 or 5 pm central time.
Here is the link:
[url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCCS0uX_JDG_3OBPt2jYQsfw ]WorldsDev YouTube Channel[/url]
Subscribe if you want ,that will help to let more people know about the game.

That would be all for this one and remember that your feedback is very important so if you have any ideas/suggestions for improvement make sure to post them this will help to make a better game!

If you find any bug while playing it would be very much appreciated if you report them on the discussions section and thanks to all of you have report them.

That would be all for now and like always [b]Thank you[/b] for your support! and believing in The Capture Worlds!

the money depends on what floor you are it's like this: Tower Level * (Random between 90 to 120).
